{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'\nNumber of customer_age == -1: {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]}')

# Check revenue format
print(f'\nUnique revenue values (first 10): {df["revenue"].unique()[:10]}')

# Check for QA orders
print(f'\nNumber of revenue == 999999.99: {df[df["revenue"] == "999999.99"].shape[0]}')

# Check status values
print(f'\nUnique status values: {df["status"].unique()}')

# Check for duplicates
print(f'\nNumber of duplicate order_id: {df["order_id"].duplicated().sum()}')"}
